top_signals.title: Peru Unexpectedly Holds Rate as Inflation Jump Seen as Temporary
top_signals.summary: Peru unexpectedly left borrowing costs unchanged for a 13th straight month as policymakers expect a recent acceleration in inflation to prove temporary.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trading platform Webull's China ties create national security risk, congressional panel finds; stock drops 18%
top_signals.summary: A congressional committee says trading platform Webull is not the ordinary U.S. company it claims, but exposes customer data to Chinese surveillance risk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
